answer: Each challenge is derived with domain-separated hashing from a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse, so its unpredictable value is unavailable for advance computation. Commit-reveal binds each response to that challenge, while verifier checks prevent replay across tasks. Seeds such as comet, vault, and trellis label distinct challenge domains; this makes offline farming and reusable work by automated sybil swarms uneconomical, though it does not by itself prevent identity creation.
